info.title: polyGraphics 3D Backend
info.description: API for 2D-to-3D reconstruction. Default path: **Segment Anything first** (smart background removal), then MapAnything / mesh or Gaussian splatting — reconstructions consume **masked** views only. `skip_sam_segmentation` is only for pre-cut **RGBA** assets with real transparency.

video.description: Single video file (.mp4, .mov, .webm). Uploaded and processed immediately.

capture_metadata.description: Optional JSON text payload from Android capture session with per-frame orientation/depth/quality info. Stored at uploads/{job_id}/capture_metadata.json.

HangerPointBody.title: HangerPointBody
HangerPointBody.description: Backward-compatible hanger-only body (``{ x, y, z }``).

stage.title: Stage
stage.description: Current pipeline stage. UI should switch on the base value (before any space). Lifecycle: starting | exporting | completed. Pipeline protocol: phase_0_input_curation | phase_1_segmentation | phase_2_alignment | phase_3_sanitization | phase_4_colmap_bridge | phase_4_colmap_scene | phase_5_gaussian_splatting | phase_confidence_routing | phase_prior_generation | phase_prior_refinement. Mesh-only: meshing | mesh_cleanup | vertex_color_transfer | photo_vertex_bake | color_autobalance | exporting. Optional GS comparison meshes: compare_mesh_preview. May include a human suffix in parens, e.g. 'phase_1_segmentation (3/27)'.

progress.title: Progress
progress.description: Pipeline progress in percent (0-100). Null until processing starts.

image_sample_url.title: Image Sample Url
image_sample_url.description: URL of the first uploaded image for this job (preview thumbnail). Relative by default; absolute when APP_MODEL_BASE_URL is set to a non-loopback URL. Derived per response; not persisted.

masked_view_urls.title: Masked View Urls
masked_view_urls.description: URLs of SAM-isolated RGB frames (black outside mask) under uploads/{job_id}/masked_views/ when ``expose_masked_views`` mirroring ran or the worker POSTed masked views. Derived per response; not persisted.

masked_preview_page_url.title: Masked Preview Page Url
masked_preview_page_url.description: Relative URL of an HTML page that lists masked_view_urls as thumbnails — open in a browser (same origin as this API). Derived per response; not persisted.

capture_quality_score.title: Capture Quality Score
capture_quality_score.description: Capture quality score (0..1) produced by backend pre-filtering; derived per response.

capture_rejected_images.title: Capture Rejected Images
capture_rejected_images.description: Image basenames rejected by capture quality filtering; derived per response.

capture_kept_images.title: Capture Kept Images
capture_kept_images.description: Image basenames kept after capture curation stage; derived per response.

reconstruction_confidence.title: Reconstruction Confidence
reconstruction_confidence.description: Confidence score used by backend routing (0..1). Derived per response.

quality_reason.title: Quality Reason
quality_reason.description: Human-readable short reason attached to route selection.

dominant_surface_regions_detected.title: Dominant Surface Regions Detected
dominant_surface_regions_detected.description: How many dominant surface regions were extracted across views.

per_view_region_confidence.title: Per View Region Confidence
per_view_region_confidence.description: Per-view confidence scores for dominant surface region extraction/projection.

region_projection_coverage.title: Region Projection Coverage
region_projection_coverage.description: Projection coverage metrics (for example mesh_area_ratio and regions_projected).

texture_route_taken.title: Texture Route Taken
texture_route_taken.description: Texture route used: mapanything | surface_region | surface_region+mapanything_fill.

texture_quality_reason.title: Texture Quality Reason
texture_quality_reason.description: Reason associated with texture route and quality assessment.

texture_report_url.title: Texture Report Url
texture_report_url.description: Relative URL to uploads/{job_id}/texture_report.json when available.

selected_frame_url.title: Selected Frame Url
selected_frame_url.description: URL of the frame chosen for 3D reconstruction (set for video/InstantMesh jobs). Derived per response; not persisted.

capture_metadata_url.title: Capture Metadata Url
capture_metadata_url.description: Relative URL to uploads/{job_id}/capture_metadata.json when app metadata is uploaded.

capture_metadata_version.title: Capture Metadata Version
capture_metadata_version.description: Capture metadata schema version provided by the client app.

capture_total_frames.title: Capture Total Frames
capture_total_frames.description: Total captured frames reported by client metadata summary.

capture_accepted_frames.title: Capture Accepted Frames
capture_accepted_frames.description: Accepted frames reported by client metadata summary.

capture_avg_quality_score.title: Capture Avg Quality Score
capture_avg_quality_score.description: Average per-frame quality score from app metadata summary (0..1).

capture_orbit_coverage_deg.title: Capture Orbit Coverage Deg
capture_orbit_coverage_deg.description: Estimated orbit coverage in degrees from app metadata summary.

JobStatus.title: JobStatus
JobStatus.description: PENDING = images saved; call POST /jobs/{id}/start to run the pipeline.

url.title: Url
url.description: Download URL for this asset (same rules as job.model_url: relative /output/... or APP_MODEL_BASE_URL).

image_url.title: Image Url
image_url.description: URL of the first uploaded input image for this job (preview). Same construction as job.image_sample_url.

x.title: X
x.description: X in normalized try-on space, clamped to [-1, 1].

y.title: Y
y.description: Y in normalized try-on space, clamped to [-1, 1].

z.title: Z
z.description: Z in normalized try-on space, clamped to [-1, 1].

ModelPoint3D.title: ModelPoint3D
ModelPoint3D.description:
Point in normalized try-on model space (matches frontend ``prepareTryOnModel``).

The mesh is centered at the origin and the largest axis of its bounding box is 1.0 unit.
Components are clamped to [-1, 1] on write.
